title: Top seed Alex Eala begins Asian Games campaign in 2nd round

blocks.text: SINGAPORE–Alex Eala earned a first-round bye as the top seed in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. Eala begins her women’s singles campaign in the continental showcase in the second round against the winner between Thailand’s Patcharin Cheapchandej and Mahin Aftab Qureshi of Pakistan. The 21-year-old Eala headlines the top half of the draw, which also features No. 4 seed Wang Xiyu of China, No. 6 Moyuka Uchijima of Japan and No. 8 Joanna Garland of Chinese Taipei.
